Subject: Coordination: Redwood SE demo + security & procurement prerequisites

Tom —

Thanks for the quick follow-up on interest from Atlas. We'd like to run a focused technical demo with our Solutions Engineering team and your engineers to validate integration points and surface any security/procurement prerequisites ahead of a POC. A few goals for the session: 

- Walk through typical request flow and networking (VPC, egress controls)
- Confirm data handling / retention expectations for regulated records
- Surface any integration blockers (auth, proxy, on-prem connectors)
- Agree next steps and owners for procurement checklist

Suggested formats (30–60 minutes):
- 45m tech demo + 15m Q&A (recommended)
- 60m deep dive if you want to include network/security folks live

Proposed windows (PST):
- Wed Apr 7: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Thu Apr 8: 09:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30

Can you confirm who from Atlas needs to join (security, infra, procurement)? If procurement needs a copy of a draft SOW or commercial terms ahead of the call, we can attach the SOW-draft.docx and a one-page cost estimate.

I’m looping Priyom (SE) to propose the final agenda and run the demo.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
